_comment: RECORD-ONLY placeholder thresholds for DeepSeek-V4 284B (deepseek4-284b / DeepSeek-V4-Flash MoE) on MI325X distributed, keyed by sweep name. Every metric is kind='info' so it always PASSES (no gating) -- we have NO measured MI325X baselines for this model yet. After the first clean runs, replace the tflops/tokens `info` entries with `min` gates and final_loss with a `max` gate, then set enforce_thresholds=true in the config. The sweep key MUST match the config's sweep name exactly.
